coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

milestones.text: Official groundbreaking for the Mission Bay Branch Library, a 7,500 sq ft branch at 960 4th St (funded by the $105.9M Branch Library Improvement Program bond measure approved by voters in Nov 2000)

changes.text: Corrected the Mission Bay Branch Library's completion milestone -- the existing entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak DataSF Assessor guess. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed in the second Gemini-verification pass, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. This was verified but never actually applied to the data in that earlier pass -- caught while double-checking the data-quality report.

Mission Bay Branch Library added as a real, active Assessor-parcel record (blklot 8708110, 960 4th St, built 2005) -- the Assessor tax roll's own property_location field for this blklot reads '201 BERRY ST', a stale corner-frontage address rather than the library's current 4th St address, the same kind of discrepancy already documented for The Exchange on 16th.

record.notes: Mission Bay Branch Library, 960 4th St -- San Francisco Public Library branch, 7,499 sq ft, single story, built 2005 (DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Roll: property_class_code_definition 'LIBRARY', year_property_built 2005).
